name: gas_turbine_reheat
title: Gas turbine with reheat (intercooler and regenerator)
summary: Two-shaft ideal-gas air turbine with two compression stages, water-cooled intercooler, regenerator, main combustion chamber, HP turbine driving the compressors, second (reheat) combustion chamber and LP turbine expanding to ambient pressure; computes the extra fuel consumption and the cycle efficiency with reheat.

authors: TBD (ULiège course MECA0002; inventory suggests S. Quoilin with repetition assistants N. Paulus and B. Dechesne)
origin.course: Thermodynamique appliquée (THD10), repetition session 7, exercise 4 (2010 exercise, reused in 2022-2023)

verification.reference: EES stored solution in the source file (98 variables, kPa/kJ unit system converted for comparison)
verification.notes: Maximum over all common variables as printed (3.40e-01 on s[3]) is a reference-state offset: EES ideal-gas Air and CoolProp Air do not share the h/s zero (offset ≈ 126 kJ/kg on h, ≈ 1814 J/kg-K on s). On derived results (temperature rises, powers, fuel flows, efficiency) the maximum is 9.8e-03 (eta_tg 0.3297 EES vs 0.3265 CoolSolve), explained by the different air property backends (EES ideal-gas polynomials vs CoolProp pseudo-pure Air).
